data.name: Toy Chute A Sorting Game
data.detailed_description:
Sort in silence. Or sort in song.

Somewhere out past the last shipping lane, a station full of lost toys drifts in zero gravity — thousands of them, each one stranger and cuter than the last. Your job is simple: catch them, read them, and send them home through the right chute. Your real job; the one you won't be able to stop doing; is turning every single sort into music.

ToyChute is a zero-gravity sorting game where satisfaction has two layers. The first is the one you know: the deeply pleasing click of getting something into exactly the right place. The second is yours to invent; because scattered through every level are Combo Rings, and every toy (or every you) that drifts through one plays a note. Line your chutes through the right rings, in the right order, at the right rhythm, and suddenly you're not just tidying up; you're composing.

Push off a wall. Drift. Grab a toy out of the void with a satisfying thunk, feel its weight as you haul it in. Charge up a throw and send it spiraling exactly where it needs to go, threading it through a ring on the way just because the note it makes is the one your melody needs next. There's no up, no down, no rushing; just you, the toys, and the sound you're building one throw at a time.

Why you'll love it:

  • A galaxy of toys. Thousands of unique, cutie-pie collectibles to spot, catch, and learn; no two floating past you feel quite the same.

  • Zero-gravity movement that feels like flying. Full freedom of motion; push, drift, boost, and grab your way through open space with weight and momentum that actually feel real.

  • Sorting that's actually satisfying. Chutes, categories, and a growing collection log that turns "just tidying up" into something genuinely compulsive.

  • Combo Rings; your instrument. Every ring rings a note. Route your throws through them and turn cleanup into composition; cycle through scales, chain melodies, and make the station sing.

  • Made for messing around. No fail states chasing you; just an endless, cozy puzzle box of toys, physics, and music, entirely on your own time.

Come for the sorting. Stay because you just figured out how to play piano with a shelf full of toys.

data.short_description: Float through zero gravity, grab thousands of adorable toys, and launch them into the right chutes to get everything organized. Hit Combo Rings along the way to play musical notes, chain your shots together, and create your own zero-G melody. Wigi Wigi...
